rule: forecast_live_filtered: live running-max truncation computed on the running maximum of a trailing 5-minute rolling median of the 1-minute ASOS readings, instead of the raw readings. Same tilt weights (0.3 touched, 0.001 cleared by 1F), same 5-minute feed delay, same walk-forward b/fee selection as every other maker.
why_this_window: Matches the cadence of the public 5-minute feed the maker is assumed to see; not chosen by comparing PnL.
diagnosis: NYC full-year replay only. The four NYC days where plain truncation lost most against the forecast-only maker (2026-07-31, 2026-01-14, 2025-12-13, and the margin-setting outliers 2025-10-09, 2026-04-10, 2026-03-29) each had a single 1-minute reading at the day maximum; the 5-minute rolling median stayed at or below the official high + 1F.
primary_held_out_comparisons: forecast_live_filtered - forecast_live (same settings), per city and pooled over the six held-out cities
